source: QuickTone 2.6.7.16: string table in the translation unit that also references UI_MIDI_Image_Title_MG300MK2_MG400 (the MG300MK2 Custom MIDI panel). Table index == default CC number (assumption, see confidence).

confidence.default_cc_equals_index: likely: device cmd 0F returns an identity-looking table; the analogous MG-400 table (same panel family, without 'P.L Position') matches CCs observed on real MG-400 hardware by willianszwy/mg-400 (type CC 1-10, knob bases 14/18/24/32/44/48/54/62/66, CC77 current block, CC79 scene)
confidence.mg300mk2_vs_mg400_shift: MG-300MK2 table has an extra 'P.L Position' at 77, so Current Block=78, Pedal=79, Scene=80 (MG-400: 77/78/79). Must be confirmed on hardware.
confidence.scene_offset_column: likely (MG-30 layout analogy); AMP knobs 1-6, RVB knob 4 and model CCs verified via forge file diffs

other_messages.program_change: PC 0-based preset number (MG-30 family convention; pedal emits C0 <preset> on identity request per FACTS)
other_messages.scene_select: CC80 value 0-2 (per this table; MG-400 uses CC79)
other_messages.custom_midi_table_sysex: cmd 0F get returns 99-byte table (FACTS: identity-looking). 92 named functions here; 7 extra entries unknown.
notes: MG-30 family pedals drop messages sent <40 ms apart
MG-30: incoming CC does not redraw screen; MG-400: CC edits apply to the active scene's edit buffer only
Changing a model via CC resets that block's knobs to model defaults (MG-400 notes)
